rules.statement: The judge had the discretion to order a pleading to be taken off the file when the proceedings were unauthorized, but this was not warranted in the circumstances of the case.
rules.supporting_quote: It has not been usual, so far as I can find, to order a pleading to be 'taken off the file' when the proceedings are unauthorized. In the English Equity cases an opportunity is given to perfect the authority, if possible.
